global: A rich, golden miso ramen broth cradles tender chashu pork and crisp menma. A single nori sheet rests atop, all nestled in a white bowl on a dark tray, illuminated by warm, ambient light.

regions.background: Dark wooden table with glossy finish, reflecting light, showing grain patterns and subtle texture.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with subtle black calligraphy near rim, smooth glossy surface, slightly curved and thickened edge.
regions.soup: The miso broth is golden-yellow, glossy, and rich, swirling around noodles and garnishes with visible green herbs and foam.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, slightly textured, triangular-shaped, with uneven edges and a glossy surface.
regions.meat: The chashu pork has a glistening, tender texture with marbled fat and a slightly curled, irregular shape.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with soft, fibrous texture and irregular, curved shape.
